analysis_steps.goal: Measure line centres and peak Tb

method.value: Quadratic fit to peak pixel and two neighbours, averaged over images at 0 and ±100 m/s offsets

evidence.quote: This approach fits a quadratic curve to the pixel of peak intensity and the two neighbouring pixels.

validation.value: Uncertainty below 10% of the channel width

evidence.quote: we achieve a precision of less than 10% of the channel width

analysis_steps.goal: Fit Keplerian rotation model and make residual map

method.value: Fit Keplerian v0 map with eddy, average 250 posterior samples, subtract from data

evidence.quote: We take the average of 250 random samples of the posterior distributions to create a model rotation map, $v_{\rm mod}$.

key_parameters.value: 256 walkers, 500 burn-in steps, 10,000 sampling steps; fit region 0.26'' to 3.75''

evidence.quote: utilises 256 walkers which take 500 steps to burn in, then an additional 10, 000 steps to sample the posterior distribution function
we fix it at $5.8\ensuremath{^\circ}$ based on trial runs

assumptions.value: Keplerian, razor-thin disk; flat priors (M* 0.1-2 Msun)

evidence.quote: This approach makes the implicit assumption that the rotation profile of Keplerian

fitting.value: MCMC with emcee after scipy.optimize start; flat priors

evidence.quote: The fitting starts with an optimisation of the free parameters of using `scipy.optimize` which is then used as the starting positions for an MCMC exploration

validation.value: Four runs, including elevated emission surface; model scatter ~1%

evidence.quote: all four runs found PDFs for the free parameters which resulted in an average standard deviation in $v_{\rm mod}$ of $\sim 1\%$

analysis_steps.goal: Fit Archimedean spirals and pitch angles

method.value: Linear spiral r = a + b phi fitted by eye; pitch angle tan beta = -(dr/dphi)/r

claims.hypothesis: Spiral structure exists in the gas velocity and temperature of TW Hya
claims.experiment: Subtract azimuthally symmetric models from 12CO 3-2 maps
claims.result: One velocity spiral and two temperature spirals found, ~5 sigma per pixel but coherent

evidence.quote: Three dominant spirals are found, one in velocity and two in gas temperature

claims.hypothesis: A Lindblad-resonance wake from the 94 au planet explains the spirals
claims.experiment: Compare Bae & Zhu wake model to the observed spirals
claims.finding: Spirals not readily explained by Lindblad wake; other mechanism (e.g. buoyancy) possible

evidence.quote: the spirals are not generated by Lindblad resonances but rather by another mechanism

limitations_admitted.value: Cannot fully break degeneracy between velocity components
